name: Studies
title: studiesapp.com
shortDescription: Studies is a versatile flashcard app designed for students and professionals aiming to memorize important information. It supports various content types like text, images, audio, and video across devices such as Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Ideal for learning languages, preparing for tests, or mastering complex subjects, Studies enhances efficient learning through scientifically-based schedules and interactive study sessions.
cons: No free version, only a free trial
